narr: Another complex of thunderstorms developed the night of the 8th into the 9th across the Northern Plains and pushed eastward across the Northland during the morning hours. This round was not as intense as the round the previous morning, but did still produce some damaging winds and isolated flash flooding in parts of the Arrowhead as it moved through.
